description: Reference values for the validation suite. Published values are transcribed from L. Wang and S. L. Jacques, 'Monte Carlo Modeling of Light Transport in Multi-layered Tissues in Standard C' (the MCML manual), chapter 6, and were checked against the manual's PDF. A reference with 'se' carries a published standard error. One with 'n_photons' and no 'se' came without one, so its standard error is estimated from ours scaled by the photons behind it. 'decimals' is the number of decimals printed, which gives a rounding allowance of half a unit in the last place. Entries with 'oracle' are computed by python/tissuemc_analysis/oracle.py.

v1_slab.title: V1: slab with matched boundary (MCML manual Table 6.1)

v2_semi_infinite.title: V2: semi-infinite, n = 1.5, isotropic (MCML manual Table 6.2)
v2_semi_infinite.note: The Table 6.2 values match the TOTAL reflectance (diffuse + specular, Rsp = 0.04), not the diffuse part alone: the independent oracle gives 0.2197 diffuse and 0.2597 total, and all three published values sit near 0.26. Tables 6.1 and 6.7 are diffuse-only.

o1_semi_infinite_matched.title: O1: semi-infinite, matched boundary, isotropic (H-function oracle)

v3_three_layer.title: V3: three-layer tissue (MCML manual Tables 6.6 and 6.7)
v3_three_layer.note: Table 6.7 gives no standard errors, so the published values' errors are estimated from ours scaled by the photons behind each: 1,000,000 for MCML and 100,000 for Gardner.
